name: Steak & Vietnamese noodle salad
assumptions: Recipe serves 2 based on 250g steak and 85g dry noodles as main components, standard for 2 adult portions in similar BBC Good Food recipes
Preparation and cooking time estimated at 25 minutes: ~5 min dressing, ~5-10 min noodles + veg prep, ~6-10 min steak cooking + 5 min rest
Gluten-free assumes rice noodles, rice vinegar, and fish sauce are certified gluten-free (common but not always guaranteed)
Soy null due to possible presence in some fish sauce brands
Shellfish null as fish sauce origin is ambiguous (could be anchovy-based but not confirmed as shellfish)
No barley/rye/wheat or uncertified oats present; wheat-free but classified separately as gluten-free true only if certified
All ingredients screened conservatively from listed items only; no unlisted sauces or compounds assumed
instructions:
step 1
Mix all the ingredients for the dressing together in a bowl with 1 tbsp water until the sugar has dissolved.

step 2
Cook the noodles following pack instructions, then plunge into a bowl of cold water to cool completely. Drain the noodles, then add the carrot, cabbage, spring onion and dressing, and toss to combine.

step 3
Heat the oil in a frying pan over a high heat. Season the steak, then cook to your liking; 2-3 mins on each side for medium rare. Leave to rest for 5 mins, then slice. Divide the salad and steak slices between bowls and scatter over some coriander to serve.

ingredients.name: Brown Rice Noodle
ingredients.assumptions: Standard dry brown rice noodles; typical 350-370 kcal/100g dry weight used.

ingredients.name: Rapeseed Oil
ingredients.assumptions: 1 tsp rapeseed oil weighs ~5g; standard vegetable oil values.

ingredients.name: Fillet Of Steak
ingredients.assumptions: Raw lean fillet steak; typical values for beef tenderloin.

ingredients.name: Carrots
ingredients.assumptions: 2 medium carrots ~120g total; raw peeled weight.

ingredients.name: Chinese Cabbage
ingredients.assumptions: Half a medium Chinese/napa cabbage ~350g edible portion; raw.

ingredients.name: Spring Onions
ingredients.assumptions: 4 medium spring onions ~60g total; raw, including green tops.

ingredients.name: Coriander
ingredients.assumptions: A small handful of fresh coriander leaves ~20g.

ingredients.name: Red Chilli
ingredients.assumptions: 1 medium red chilli ~20g; raw, including seeds.

ingredients.name: Lime
ingredients.assumptions: Juice of 1 lime ~40g; typical lime juice values.

ingredients.name: Brown Sugar
ingredients.assumptions: 2 tsp brown sugar ~8g; standard granulated sugar values.

ingredients.name: Rice Vinegar
ingredients.assumptions: 1 tsp rice vinegar ~5g; typical low-calorie rice vinegar.

ingredients.name: Fish Sauce
ingredients.assumptions: 1/2 tablespoon fish sauce ~9g (1 tbsp ~18g); typical values.
